# skycloak_test_identity_provider (Action)

Validates an identity provider's connection (discovery, credentials) and fails on an unreachable or misconfigured provider.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `provider_id` (String) Identity provider alias.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `client_id` (String) Override client ID for this test only. Not persisted.
- `client_secret` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Override client secret or LDAP bind password for this test only. Not persisted.
